newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Prazske Pivovary Q1 CZK 107mln loss.
newsitem.headline: Czech Prazske Pivovary Q1 CZK 107mln loss.

text.p: Czech brewer Prazske Pivovary a.s. , 55 percent owned by Britain's Bass PLC, said on Friday it posted a loss of 107.24 million crowns in the first quarter of 1997.
Comparisons were unavailable because the figures are consolidated and the brewery recently merged into a new legal entity after the acquisition last year of two regional breweries.
